title: Intro to Python
intro:
Hi. It is me, Mar'tu. Before we continue on our adventure you must learn some of the language we call, Python.
The barrier, the Ley Clock, the game screen: all of them listen to Python, yes? So you will learn to speak it.
We go one small step at a time. Each lesson has short tasks, hints when you are stuck, and a quiz at the end. Nothing here is a test you can fail.
Already know some Python? Every unit has a Quick Check. Pass it and move on.
Come. Sit by the fire. We begin with words.
